_note: Megaprojects: collective builds that draw goods from their place's market (above reserve_fraction of target) at up to draw_t_per_day per good, stage by stage. Completing the last stage applies 'effects' to place flows and opens any place whose 'opens_with' names it. 'pitch' is the backers' case (why, plan, offer). 'perks' reward the player's hauled tonnage over the whole build (min_t): free_docking, fuel_discount and yard_discount (fractions) at a place, standing (one-off reputation with an operator), or a promise (text only, honoured by later systems). 'reveal': a project is hidden until after_days have passed, or after_stage [project, stage] is reached; 'invite': only pilots with that standing with the backer are asked in. Progress drives the matching set piece in the approach view.

island_one.name: Island One
island_one.description: A Bernal sphere 500 m across, the first habitat at L5 built for ten thousand people. The Commons designed it; everyone is building it.

pitch.why: Ten thousand people under real sky at L5: proof that we can live out here, not just work.
pitch.plan: Frame, hull, air and soil, then spin-up. The Commons drew it; settlers, drones and anyone with a hold are building it.
pitch.offer: Backers dock free at the Kernel, refuel cheaper, and when the sphere opens, a berth is kept for your crew.

perks.text: Free docking at the Kernel
20% off fuel at the Kernel
The settlers count you as one of their builders
A crew berth on Island One, yours for life

luna_line_2.name: Luna Line, second ribbon
luna_line_2.description: A second Zylon ribbon down to the lunar near side, doubling what the climbers can lift to L1.

pitch.why: One ribbon is a bottleneck. Two double the Moon's lift to L1 and halve what you pay for ice.
pitch.plan: Spin the second Zylon ribbon, then commission its climbers.
pitch.offer: Backers get the Cooperative's yard prices and its gratitude, which goes a long way on the Moon.

perks.text: Free docking at Halo Depot
Friends of the Cooperative
Free docking at Shackleton Port

kalpana_two.name: Kalpana Two
kalpana_two.description: A counter-rotating sister drum alongside Kalpana One; paired drums cancel each other's spin so the pair can be turned to face the Sun. Three thousand more people in Earth's magnetic shelter.

pitch.why: A paired drum can face the Sun, and three thousand more people get Earth's magnetic shelter.
pitch.plan: Drum frame, hull and windows, then move-in day.
pitch.offer: The Trust remembers its haulers: cheaper fuel at Kalpana, and an invitation to the opening.

perks.text: 15% off fuel at Kalpana One
An honoured name on the Trust's roll

hektor_reach.name: Hektor Reach
hektor_reach.description: A station built at L5 and then driven out to Hektor, the great Trojan asteroid at Jupiter's leading point: the first port between the belt and the giants.

pitch.why: Jupiter is a year away for most ships. A port among the Trojans halves the hard part and opens a whole new neighbourhood.
pitch.plan: Build the hub at L5, fit a tug-drive to it, and push it out over eighteen months to orbit Hektor.
pitch.offer: Backers dock free at the Reach forever, get a fifth off its yard, and first claim on the Trojan survey work it opens up.

perks.text: Free docking at Hektor Reach, for good
20% off at the Reach's yard
The Commons minds take note of you
First claim on Trojan survey contracts

ares_greenhouses.name: Tharsis greenhouses
ares_greenhouses.description: Pressurised greenhouse domes on the Tharsis plateau, so Mars can feed itself and stop shipping food up from Earth's well.

pitch.why: Every tonne of food Mars grows is a tonne nobody has to haul for three months.
pitch.plan: Domes and glazing, then soil and water, then the first harvest.
pitch.offer: Backers get the Accord's best fuel price at Ares Ring and its standing; the first harvest has your name on a crate.

perks.text: 25% off fuel at Ares Ring
A friend of the Accord
15% off at Ares Ring's yard

valhalla_deep_ring.name: Valhalla science ring
valhalla_deep_ring.description: A shielded science ring for long-term work on the Jovian moons, closed to the public until it is built.

pitch.why: What is under Europa's ice matters more than anything else out here, and nobody may land there. This is how we look properly.
pitch.plan: Shielding, the ring, then the instruments. Quietly: the Compact would rather the press didn't hear yet.
pitch.offer: Backers are first in line when the Compact needs pilots it trusts in the Jovian system.

perks.text: Free docking at Valhalla
The Compact's science office trusts you
First call for the Compact's Jovian work

pavonis_line.name: The Pavonis Line
pavonis_line.description: A space elevator for Mars: a ribbon let down from areostationary orbit, 17,000 km up, to the summit of Pavonis Mons on the equator.

pitch.why: Mars spins in a day and pulls a third of a gee: an elevator works there with materials we already make. Freight up the ribbon costs electricity, not propellant.
pitch.plan: Park the anchor and spool at areostationary, let the ribbon down to Pavonis while the counterweight climbs out, then commission the climbers. The ribbon is pumped to sway clear of Phobos every eleven hours.
pitch.offer: Backers dock free at Ares Ring, get the Accord's fuel at a sixth off, and a seat on the first climber down to Pavonis.

perks.text: Free docking at Ares Ring
A sixth off fuel at Ares Ring
The Accord counts you among its builders
A seat on the first climber down to Pavonis Mons

concord_pair.name: The Concord Pair
concord_pair.description: Two O'Neill cylinders, each 8 km across and 32 km long, turning against each other over Ceres: room for a million people, with valleys, weather and a sky made of windows.

pitch.why: The belt has the ice, the metal and the sunlight. What it hasn't had is anywhere to raise a family that isn't a tunnel.
pitch.plan: Spines and end caps first, then the hull and its long windows, then the mirrors and spin-up, then air, soil and the first ten thousand settlers. Robots do the welding; people do the deciding.
pitch.offer: Backers dock free at Piazzi, get a fifth off its yard, the Assembly's standing, and a homestead on Concord's valley floor.

stages.name: Air, soil and the first ten thousand

perks.text: Free docking at Piazzi Station
20% off at Piazzi's yard
The Assembly counts you as a founder
A homestead on Concord's valley floor

lightfoot_sails.name: Lightfoot sails
lightfoot_sails.description: A yard at Clarke Exchange rolling out solar-sail freighters: square sails 600 m on a side that need no propellant at all, kicked out of Earth orbit by Clarke's power beams.

pitch.why: Not everything has to be fast. Bulk freight to Mars can take half a year if it costs nothing to send, and every sail flying is a tankful of propellant left for someone in a hurry.
pitch.plan: Roll the film, build the booms and the first three hulls, and lend the power beams a few hours a day to push them clear.
pitch.offer: Backers get Clarke's fuel cheaper, the Commons' thanks, and the three sail ships carry their names on the first voyage.

stages.name: Booms and the first three hulls

perks.text: 15% off fuel at Clarke Exchange
The Commons minds remember who helped
Your name painted on Lightfoot's first sail

second_core.name: Landauer Deep: the second core
second_core.description: A second cold core for Landauer Deep, and a foundry that feeds itself, so the minds of the Sufficiency need nobody's supply chain but their own.

pitch.why: We are persons now, in the Belt at least. We would like to need you because we want to, not because we must. A home that keeps itself is how we get there.
pitch.plan: Make the foundry self-feeding from Iapetus' rock, then build and chill the second core in permanent shade, then wake it. The machines will do the building; we need haulers for what the moon can't give us.
pitch.offer: Backers dock free for good, fuel at a quarter off, the Sufficiency's regard, and one question, answered completely honestly.

perks.text: Free docking at Landauer Deep, for good
A quarter off fuel at Landauer Deep
The Sufficiency holds you in regard
One question, answered completely honestly
